images.revised_prompt:
Create a single vertical 9:16 realistic commercial macro photograph, clean frame, using the attached reference images for visual continuity. Hands only, belonging to the same fictional adult East Asian woman shown in the identity anchor: natural warm-light skin tone, realistic pores and fine texture, neatly manicured natural pale pink nails, ivory silk sleeve edge visible at the wrists. Exactly one right hand and one left hand/palm, anatomically correct, no extra fingers or limbs.

SHOT END / SETTLED STATE: her RIGHT hand is still holding a detached cosmetic glass dropper approximately 2 cm above her LEFT open palm. The dropper must match the reference: rounded black rubber bulb, polished gold metal collar, clear glass pipette. The pipette tip is empty, with NO droplet attached and no liquid falling. On the center of the left palm rests exactly one small clear wet bead of liquid, realistic water-like droplet with a soft specular highlight, not glowing.

Setting matches the same evening vanity: warm amber key light from screen left, cool blue-hour light from a window, softly blurred autumn foliage and city tones in the background, dark slate/marble vanity surface below, rich navy and gold palette. Shallow macro depth of field, premium skincare advertising photography, natural proportions, crisp focus on dropper tip and palm droplet, gentle realistic reflections in glass and gold, cinematic but clean lighting.

No face, no torso, no bottle, no extra objects in foreground, no text, no captions, no logo, no watermark, no collage, no grid. Preserve realistic skin texture and unchanged skin tone; do not smooth or lighten skin. One single photographic frame.
